children: Overview
U.S. breast imaging device maker's Q3 revenue rose 75% yr/yr to $7.3 mln
Q3 net loss narrowed sharply to $0.3 mln from $4.6 mln a year ago
2026 revenue guidance cut to $34 mln due to Middle East shipment delays
Outlook
QT Imaging lowers 2026 revenue guidance to approximately $34 mln from $39 mln
Company says international shipment delays due to Middle East conflict impact 2026 outlook
Medicare hospital outpatient payment for QTscan exams to begin Jan 1, 2027
Result Drivers
SCANNER SALES - Q3 revenue growth driven by higher sales of Breast Acoustic CT scanners, per co
MANUFACTURING EXPANSION - Co said relocation to new facility doubled manufacturing capacity and improved efficiency
REIMBURSEMENT PROGRESS - CMS decision to establish Medicare hospital outpatient payment for QTscan exams seen as supporting future U.S. hospital expansion
